# Plot function atlas: all 22 visualizations

**Coverage:** 22 / 22 exported `aqt_plot_*` functions from the published R API. **16 native base-R outputs are rendered through the actual functions below**; the **six optional `rgl` visualizations use explicitly labeled 2D projections of the same invented input**, because a headless static documentation build cannot faithfully substitute an interactive `rgl` scene. The documented native `rgl` call is provided for each.

All plots use **invented synthetic coordinates, synthetic study designs, or synthetic plotting fixtures**, not real GoPro frames, biological feeding reference labels, physical surveyed underwater targets, or treatment effects. These examples are for software teaching. They cannot certify fish detection, calibrated XYZ accuracy, uncertainty coverage, animal welfare or causal inference.

```{r gallery-setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8.8, fig.height = 5.6, fig.align = "center",
  fig.retina = 2, dev = "png", out.width = "100%"
)
library(aquaTrajectories)
set.seed(20261116)
toy2 <- aqt_simulate_tracks(n_fish = 5L, n_frames = 90L,
                            fps = 10, dimension = 2L, seed = 11L)
toy3 <- aqt_simulate_tracks(n_fish = 5L, n_frames = 90L,
                            fps = 10, dimension = 3L, seed = 12L)
one2 <- aqt_tracks(as.data.frame(toy2)[toy2$track_id == "fish1", ],
                   units = "cm", coordinate_system = "tank")
one3 <- aqt_tracks(as.data.frame(toy3)[toy3$track_id == "fish1", ],
                   units = "cm", coordinate_system = "tank")
ensemble2 <- aqt_trajectory_ensemble(one2, sigma = .14,
                                     draws = 25L, seed = 44L)
ensemble3 <- aqt_trajectory_ensemble(one3, sigma = .14,
                                     draws = 25L, seed = 45L)
group_summary <- aqt_group_spatial_summary(toy3)
scene3 <- aqt_tank_scene_snapshot(toy3, frame_s = 5, tail_s = 2,
                                  max_age_s = .11, max_gap_s = .11)
voxel_breaks <- lapply(c("x", "y", "z"), function(n)
  seq(floor(min(one3[[n]]) - .5), ceiling(max(one3[[n]]) + .5),
      length.out = 9L))
names(voxel_breaks) <- c("x", "y", "z")
voxels <- aqt_voxel_occupancy(one3, breaks = voxel_breaks, by = "fish")
recurrence <- aqt_trajectory_recurrence(one2, radius = .6,
                                         store_matrix = TRUE)
pca_fit <- aqt_trajectory_grid_pca(toy2, n_grid = 48L,
                                   n_components = 2L, max_gap_s = .11)
cp_t <- seq(0, 11.9, by = .1)
cp_signal <- c(rnorm(40, .6, .08), rnorm(40, 1.5, .08),
               rnorm(40, .9, .08))
cp_fit <- aqt_state_changepoint(
  data.frame(session_id = "S01", camera_id = "SIM", track_id = "fish1",
             time_s = cp_t, speed = cp_signal),
  penalty = 1.5, min_segment = 12L, max_gap_s = .11)
qc_frame <- as.data.frame(toy3)
qc_frame$reprojection_rmse_px <- pmax(.03, abs(rnorm(nrow(qc_frame), .6, .25)))
qc_frame$time_skew_s <- runif(nrow(qc_frame), .001, .025)
qc_tracks <- aqt_tracks(qc_frame, units = "cm", coordinate_system = "tank")
tank_epoch <- expand.grid(tank_id = paste0("T", 1:8),
                          epoch = c("baseline", "response"),
                          KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
tank_epoch$treatment <- ifelse(as.integer(sub("T", "", tank_epoch$tank_id)) <= 4,
                               "control", "treatment")
tank_epoch$value <- .85 + .05*as.integer(sub("T", "", tank_epoch$tank_id)) +
  ifelse(tank_epoch$epoch == "response", 
         ifelse(tank_epoch$treatment == "treatment", .35, .05), 0) +
  rnorm(nrow(tank_epoch), 0, .04)
tank_fit <- aqt_tank_event_contrast(tank_epoch, draws = 120L, seed = 19L)
feeding <- expand.grid(
  scenario = c("Normal", "Reduced", "Overfed", "No feeding"),
  time_min = seq(-10, 50, by = 2),
  rep = seq_len(3), KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
feeding$fbi <- pmax(0, pmin(1, .3 +
  c(Normal = .26, Reduced = .13, Overfed = .35, 'No feeding' = .02)[feeding$scenario] *
  exp(-((feeding$time_min-9)/14)^2) + rnorm(nrow(feeding), sd = .05)))
feeding$phase <- ifelse(feeding$time_min < 0, "pre",
                        ifelse(feeding$time_min < 10, "onset",
                               ifelse(feeding$time_min < 30, "later", "post")))
headings <- data.frame(
  condition = rep(c("Illustrative A", "Illustrative B"), each = 240L),
  heading_rad = c(rnorm(240, .7, .4), rnorm(240, 3.0, .5)))
occupancy <- expand.grid(
  scenario = c("Illustrative baseline", "Illustrative event"),
  tank_id = paste0("T", 1:5), time_s = seq(0, 1800, by = 60),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# A tank belongs to precisely one scenario; IDs must not be reused across arms.
occupancy$tank_id <- paste(occupancy$scenario, occupancy$tank_id, sep = "_")
occupancy$area_fraction <- pmax(0, pmin(1,
  .32 + ifelse(occupancy$scenario == "Illustrative event", .12, 0) +
  .06*sin(occupancy$time_s/450) + rnorm(nrow(occupancy), 0, .04)))
speed_data <- expand.grid(tank_id = paste0("T", 1:6),
                          time_s = seq(-30, 60, by = 1),
                          KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
speed_data$speed <- pmax(.05, 1 + 
  .04*as.integer(sub("T", "", speed_data$tank_id)) +
  ifelse(speed_data$time_s >= 0, .3, 0) +
  rnorm(nrow(speed_data), 0, .10))
targets <- data.frame(
  target_id = paste0("target", 1:40),
  partition = rep(c("fit", "holdout"), c(10, 30)),
  truth_x = runif(40, 0, 20), truth_y = runif(40, 0, 10),
  truth_z = runif(40, 0, 10))
calibration <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(c("Ray model", "Underwater model", "Air model")),
  function(i) {
    d <- targets; d$method <- c("Ray model", "Underwater model", "Air model")[i]
    d$estimate_x <- d$truth_x + rnorm(nrow(d), sd = c(.05, .16, .35)[i])
    d$estimate_y <- d$truth_y + rnorm(nrow(d), sd = c(.05, .16, .35)[i])
    d$estimate_z <- d$truth_z + rnorm(nrow(d), sd = c(.05, .16, .35)[i])
    d
  }))
# Plot-only conditional cloud fixture. These are invented scattered points,
# not derived from physical calibrated uncertainty or fish-video observations.
cloud_points <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(2L), function(f) {
  data.frame(track_id = paste0("fish", f), draw = seq_len(70L),
    x = rnorm(70L, f*1.6, .18), y = rnorm(70L, f*.6, .23),
    z = rnorm(70L, f*1.3, .15))
}))
cloud_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(cloud_points, cloud_points$track_id),
  function(d) data.frame(track_id = d$track_id[1L],
    x_median = median(d$x), y_median = median(d$y), z_median = median(d$z))))
cloud <- structure(list(points = cloud_points, summary = cloud_summary,
                        frame_s = 5, n_draws = 70L, units = "cm"),
                   class = "aqt_joint_scene_cloud")
# A 2D axonometric preview is used ONLY for functions whose actual graphics
# device is optional rgl; it is NOT a screenshot of that rgl output.
gallery_project <- function(x, y, z) cbind(u = x - .62*y,
                                            v = .29*x + .42*y + z)
gallery_xyz_preview <- function(x, y, z, label, groups = NULL,
                                type = "p", sizes = NULL) {
  xy <- gallery_project(x, y, z)
  if (is.null(groups)) groups <- rep("Synthetic", length(x))
  cols <- grDevices::hcl.colors(length(unique(groups)), "Dark 3")
  cc <- cols[match(groups, unique(groups))]
  plot(xy[, 1L], xy[, 2L], type = "n", asp = 1,
       xlab = "Projected X-Y (arbitrary)", ylab = "Projected height (arbitrary)",
       main = paste(label, "- 2D input preview"))
  for (g in unique(groups)) {
    idx <- which(groups == g)
    if (type == "l") lines(xy[idx, 1L], xy[idx, 2L],
                           col = cc[idx[1L]], lwd = 2)
    else points(xy[idx, 1L], xy[idx, 2L], pch = 16,
                cex = if (is.null(sizes)) .8 else sizes[idx],
                col = grDevices::adjustcolor(cc[idx[1L]], alpha.f = .65))
  }
  mtext("Projection of invented input only; NOT an rgl render",
        side = 3, line = .1, cex = .68, col = "#9B3D36")
}

```

```{r gallery-plot-path3d, fig.alt="Clearly labeled two-dimensional input projection for optional rgl function aqt_plot_path3d", fig.height=5.4, fig.width=8.8}
                    "3D fish paths", groups = toy3$track_id, type = "l")
```

Native 3D function: `aqt_plot_path3d(toy3)`. The displayed figure is only an orthographic input preview; `rgl` is required to view the actual plot.
**Optional native rgl function:** `aqt_plot_path3d(toy3)` (requires `rgl` and physical XYZ semantics where applicable). This page does **not** pretend the above projection is its native output.


**Interpretation boundary:** Invented XYZ coordinates do not establish underwater reconstruction accuracy.

<details><summary>Reproduce this example</summary>

~~~r
# Run the fixture setup from this page's source Rmd first.

~~~

## Reproducibility and limitations

The **complete synthetic fixture setup**, all 22 plot calls and the six projected-preview routines are included in this website article's source. Follow the individual function reference links for argument specifications. Only the 16 plots marked **Actual package output** are screenshots generated by invoking their own `aqt_plot_*` R function in the website build. The other six demonstrate only the input geometry and should be opened locally with optional `rgl` for native 3D.

Source code: [plot function atlas Rmd on GitHub](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/main/vignettes/articles/all-plot-functions.Rmd). For a shorter introduction, see the [five-figure workbook](five-figure-workbook.html), the [interactive synthetic teaching lab](../synthetic-explorer.html), and the [capabilities and validation matrix](capabilities-and-validation.html).
